profile.headline: Software Engineer at Chapman and Cutler LLP
profile.summary: 10+ years of Information Technology experience with a focus on the legal sector. Working to make and support tech that makes people's lives easier.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the design, development, administration, and maintenance of web-based application solutions that support critical business functions. This includes working on the Firm Intranet, custom Node.js and JavaScript-based applications, and leveraging modern development frameworks and platforms. The role collaborates closely with senior engineering staff to ensure high-quality, secure, and scalable solutions.

• Develop, enhance, and maintain software solutions using modern technologies including JavaScript, Node.js,
React, and related tools on Microsoft Azure.
• Writes clean, well-structured and maintainable code following established coding standards.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving development quality and consistency.
• Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in development and production environments.
• Contributes to system design decisions, ensuring solutions are robust, secure, and aligned with business requirements.
• Assist in improving application performance, reliability, and usability.
• Contribute to technical documentation for applications, processes, and system configurations.
• Support the development and customization of SharePoint Online components including SPFx web parts and extensions.
• Assist with integrations between SharePoint Online and other internal systems using REST APIs, web services, and connectors.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with business stakeholders and IT team members to understand requirements
and deliver effective solutions.
positions.insights: Software Development, Web Applications and +3 skills

positions.title: Application Support Analyst
positions.description:
Independently develop and/or implement software solutions for issues facing various firm groups, including growing operational needs, replacement of outdated systems, and redesign/reconfiguration of existing solutions.

Maintain and administer enterprise systems and services supporting the strategic and operational needs of the Firm. Work alongside other Chapman departments and business owners, respond to user requests, technical issues, and perform analysis and troubleshooting of systems.
positions.insights: Microsoft Power Automate, CSS and +23 skills

positions.title: Technology Trainer and Implementation Specialist
positions.description:
In addition to continuing technology training responsibilities, perform the following duties in relation to new technology implementation projects:
- Coordinate between internal groups and the vendor to ensure all aspects of the project are completed successfully and on schedule
- Consult on how to best configure a product for minimal workflow interruption and decide upon best practices for setup and usage
- Assist with technical troubleshooting of any issues that arise during the course of implementation and coordinate any needed assistance or resources
- Communicate with project vendors on troubleshooting, setup, timelines, and configuration
- Plan user communication and training where applicable
positions.insights: Adobe Creative Suite, Documentation and +32 skills

positions.title: IT Ambassador
positions.description:
- Provide remote and on-site technology support for employees and offices across the Midwest region.
 - Assist in comprehensive on-boarding of newly acquired partner offices and integration into existing Transwestern IT systems. Includes end-user assistance and network equipment setup.
 - Offer consultation on technology solutions according to the needs of team members and groups.
 - Work alongside other members of the nationwide Transwestern ITA team to address widespread IT challenges within the company.

positions.title: Desktop Support Specialist
positions.description:
- Provided desktop support for a user base of 300+ staff and faculty and represented Humanities IT within the larger IT framework of the University of Chicago.
 - Managed and assisted student technicians dealing with basic support tasks. Included both daily management as well as comprehensive training for new and existing technicians.
 - Met with and assisted faculty, staff, and departments with selection and purchasing of all new computing equipment.
 - Created written articles for the knowledge base of Desktop Support policies and procedures, in order to provide useful resources for current/future employees and end-users of varying skill levels.
 - Helped determine future hardware and software standards and policies for the Humanities Computing group, including feature configuration and promotion. Met with vendors to discuss possible hardware and software adoption options.
 - Created or adopted new processes and products to create solutions to issues facing the Humanities Computing group, including desktop management, imaging methods, and general workflow planning.
 - Represented divisional computing interests at campus-wide IT project and policy meetings, including OS standardization, O365 transition, and RFP discussions for hardware vendor selection.
- Assisted with implementation and rollout of new software and processes both internal to the division and in collaboration with the larger university IT community.

positions.title: IT Assistant III
positions.description:
- Assisted faculty, students and staff with all aspects of technical support
 - Managed, repaired, and deployed all computer/printing systems and software, including imaging and deployment
 - Utilized industry standard audio-visual systems for recording and live streaming of public events
 - Wrote the current in-use technical setup/troubleshooting manual and was partly responsible for training of all new IT student employees

volunteerExperiences.description: Assist with care and adoption of dogs in the care of PAWS, including walking/socializing, transporting, and introducing dogs to potential adopters. Assist staff with difficult to handle dogs, including walking, training, and socializing. Mentor new and lower level volunteers on shelter policies, workflows, and canine behavior. Perform various care and cleaning tasks around the shelter.

projects.title: Data Analytics Web Application
projects.description: Independently develop a web application for internal firm use that collects and processes personnel and work data from various internal firm databases and generates a customizable visualization for users to browse and manipulate. Project is hosted as an Azure App Service, contains both client and server-side functions, and is built using Typescript, Node.js, React.js, Vite, and D3.js. I am the sole developer and designer of the project.

projects.title: Intellek LMS Implementation
projects.description:
Managed the technical setup and configuration involved with migrating the firm learning management system from viDesktop to Intellek LMS. The project had a 5-week timeline from kickoff to production soft launch, which was met with all technical systems in place and functioning as desired.

- Identified aspects of the project that required assistance from other technology groups (SSO, API Data Import, Email Administration, etc) and coordinated with each group to ensure they had the required information and resources to complete their section of the project in accordance with set deadlines.
- Determined how best to migrate users and preserve/import learner data from previous system.
- Planned out implementation tasks and roadmap, including scheduling vendor meetings/trainings and project rollout dates.
- Acted as the primary point of contact with the vendor for troubleshooting, setup tasks, and configuration questions.
- Wrote a series of shell scripts to assist the firm's data architect with API troubleshooting. These were also used to handle various single-run data import tasks not delegated to the architect.
- Coordinated and participated in all manual configuration tasks handled internally by the training team.
 - Perform any follow-up troubleshooting, system management, and user support
